## Summary
Prefer a warehouse MERGE.

## Decision
Use an incremental load.

## Rationale
This is idempotent and easier to reconcile.

## Trade-offs
| Option | Pros | Cons | When to Use |
|---|---|---|---|
| Incremental | Efficient | More logic | Large tables |

1. Add staging.
2. Add tests.
